{{Dialogue|Raptus|Before our brother tasted oblivion, we had prepared to spread terror across the galaxy. We would build an endless dominion under our leadership.|Calphayus|Coruscant overgrown with our devices. Homes and families slick with blood. Billions overcome with fear and hatred.|Brontes|That day will still come. But it will not end there.|Raptus|We felt our brother's doom on Darvannis. We felt peace. When we have enslaved the galaxy, slaughter will follow.|Calphayus|Birth. Pain. Fear. Death. The cycle of existence.|Bestia|Oblivion will overtake all that is. At the end, we too will taste death's solace.|attr=The Dread Masters detail their plans|src=<ref name="RotHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dread Masters crisis''' sparked due to the [[Dread Masters]]' [[Invasion of Belsavis|escape]] from their imprisonment on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and their ambition to achieve total dominance. The Dread Masters' were freed around [[3641 BBY]] and returned to Imperial service; the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] death in the battle on [[Dromund Kaas operation|Dromund Kaas]] prompted them to enact their own plans separate from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. This resulted in several battles that pitted both the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] against them; the Dread Masters' forces were thwarted on several occasions and forced them to settle on [[Oricon]] for a final offensive.

The Republic and the Empire formed a brief truce in order [[Dread War|to confront]] the Dread Masters' after the latter used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to influence both sides' minds to drive them insane. But ultimately an offensive on Oricon resulted in the Dread Masters' deaths save [[Calphayus|one]] that the Republic captured for treatment with the Jedi.

The end to this conflict meant that both sides could focus their resources on the war since the Dread Masters' threat forced a brief stop to both sides' offensives.

==Prelude==
{{Main|Invasion of Belsavis|Raid on Asation|Attacks on Hutt Space|Battle of Denova}}
{{Quote|We are prisoners no more. Free of the Republic. Free of the Empire. Both will fall before the Dread Masters.|Dread Master [[Raptus]]|audio=PrisonsersNoMore-DreadMasters-TOR.flac|<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The [[Dread Masters]] were six powerful [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] that answered to the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] alone. These Sith earned their titles after harnessing the power contained in the [[Phobis devices]].<ref name="Phobis">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Phobis Devices}}</ref> But the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] [[Capture of the Dread Masters|captured them]] in [[3668 BBY]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] oversaw their imprisonment on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. But the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] were quick to announce that the Dread Masters had been killed to soothe concerns that the Dread Masters could escape or use their abilities to cause greater destruction.<ref name="Masters">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Dread Masters}}</ref>

Around [[3641 BBY]] an Imperial strike team infiltrated "[[the Tomb]]" located deep inside [[Belsavis prison|the prison]] on Belsavis to free the Dread Masters; this enabled the six to return to Imperial service. But the Sith Emperor's death in [[Dromund Kaas operation|the battle]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] caused them to put into motion their own plans that would put them at odds with the Empire.

Their plans to achieve domination over their enemies first started on Belsavis itself when the [[Dread Host]] tried and failed to take control of an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] weapon in [[Section X]] known as the [[Aurora Cannon]]. But a strike team dispatched to Belsavis thwarted their efforts. Their second plan was to hire [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] on [[Denova]] [[Battle of Denova|to assist them]] and to act as their proxies. Their third plan was to activate on [[Asation]] a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[hypergate]] [[Raid on Asation|to summon]] a creature known as the "[[Lotek'k|Terror from Beyond]]." But this effort failed since a strike team managed to push back the beast into the hypergate.

==The crisis==
===Arcanum raid===
{{Main|Raid on the Arcanum}}
The Sith Lord [[Tagriss]] (who decided to join the Dread Masters) was assigned [[Raid on the Arcanum|to attack]] the [[Arcanum]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Meram sector/Legends|Meram sector]] to steal dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]]. [[Darth Acina]] (who just joined the [[Dark Council]] following [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|the death]] of [[Darth Karrid]]) sent a small Imperial task force to defend the space station while the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cedral Gend]] sent a Republic team to prevent the theft of the artifacts which both sides wanted recovered.<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="TOR-DA">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Defending Arcanum|the Arcanum}}</ref><ref name="TOR-RoA">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Raid On Arcanum|the Arcanum}}</ref>

Tagriss managed to evade his pursuers in the ensuing commotion and recovered the [[Seeds of Rage]] and the [[Darkstaff]] before he fled. He fled to an [[Jedi Temple (Ilum)/Legends|old Jedi temple]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] where he attempted to unlock their power but was killed when a strike force located and engaged him in combat.<ref name="Alchemy">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|[HEROIC 4] The Alchemy of Evil|Ilum}}</ref><ref name="Uprooting">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|[HEROIC 4] Uprooting the Evil|Ilum}}</ref> This robbed the Dread Masters' of their search for important Sith artifacts and enabled the strike force to recover the stolen relics.<ref name="TOR" /><ref name="TOR" /><ref name="TOR-DA" />

===Darvannis===
{{Main|Battle of Darvannis}}
{{Quote|Once we desired an empire. Now, with the death of Lord Styrak, we are going mad.|Dread Master [[Brontes]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
The Dread Master [[Styrak]] soon grew frustrated that his fellows were failing in their attempts to achieve their plans and was displeased that their efforts thus far had been stymied. Styrak went rogue and tried to assemble a team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to pose as the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] in order to fulfill his own objectives. Styrak hoped this would remain unnoticed but a Sith and Republic task force discovered this and [[Battle of Darvannis|killed]] Styrak and his people.<ref name="SaV">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=operation|Scum and Villainy}}</ref>

===Oricon showdown===
{{Main|Dread War}}
The tide started to turn and the Republic soon discovered that the Dread Masters retreated to [[Dread Fortress|their base]] on [[Oricon]] (a planet located on the edge of Imperial space). The Republic sent a task force six hours later to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombard]] the planet from orbit to end the threat as soon as possible. But the Dread Masters were prepared and used [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|the dark side]] to project images into their opponents' minds to sow fear and terror. The [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] was forced to call upon [[Hero of Tython|other]] [[The Barsen'thor|vital]] [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Republic]] [[Voidhound|forces]] to link up with the surviving task force members in order to confront the threat together.<ref name="Days">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Days of Dread|Oricon}}</ref>

The Empire not long after discovered that Oricon was the Dread Masters' base and also discovered what had happened to the Republic's task force. [[Darth Rictus]] formed a team that Lord [[Hargrev]] would lead to Oricon to find and defeat the Dread Masters'; this team too were dealt with in the same manner as the Republic's people forcing [[Darth Marr]] to send his own important Imperial forces to locate and aid them.<ref name="Revealed">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|A Master Revealed|Oricon}}</ref>

But both sides formed a brief truce in order to defeat their common foe and crippled the Dread Host in order to weaken the Dread Masters and attack them in their fortress. The team first confronted the Dread Master [[Brontes]] and her two creations; her death allowed for the team to find a portal that led them to the Dread Masters' lair. The strike force located them in a throne room and confronted the four surviving members. The Dread Masters' summoned the spirits of their deceased members to aid them in the struggle but the resolve and strength of the task force surprised the Dread Masters' whose desperation in the struggle increased. Each Dread Master was killed in the encounter and their hold on the minds of the Imperial and Republic soldiers on the planet was broken.

==Aftermath==
In the aftermath the Dread Master [[Calphayus]] (revealed to have survived the attack on his former sanctum) stumbled across the Imperial and Republic team after having sustained injuries in the battle. But the Jedi Master [[Ogan-Dei]] deemed that the former Dread Master was broken and no longer a threat; the Republic took him in their custody as Ogan-Dei hoped that the Jedi could treat him on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].
